heading: Oilers linked to Dylan Larkin trade in Matthew Savoie-led blockbuster
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: The Edmonton Oilers are speculated to be considering a trade that would bring Detroit Red Wings center Dylan Larkin into their lineup. Reports suggest a trade package featuring Matthew Savoie along with other young prospects. However, Larkin’s contract complications and his no-trade clause could hinder any discussions. With Detroit's focus on a non-rebuilding strategy, this remains more of a theoretical scenario than a likely transaction.
